description: This file defines a mock class 'MockSystemHost' used for testing system interactions such as executing commands, file system operations, and platform info within the WebKit project. It includes methods for simulating time, sleep, and printing output, and references several mock modules.

classes.name: MockSystemHost
classes.description: A mock class simulating system host functionalities for testing purposes, including command execution, file system, platform info, user info, and output handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MockSystemHost with optional parameters for logging, OS info, and time value, setting up mock components and environment variables.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Returns the current mock time value.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Simulates sleeping by advancing the mock time by the specified number of seconds.

methods.name: print_
methods.description: Outputs arguments to the specified stream (default stdout), with customizable separator and end characters.
